title: Blood Sample Collection and PBMC Isolation Protocol
author: Carla Jones

steps.title: Collect blood into CPT tubes
steps.instruction: Using a 21‑gauge needle, draw blood from the donor and dispense into three CPT tubes per donor with the standard technique.

steps.title: Store CPT tubes before processing
steps.instruction: Keep the CPT tubes upright at room temperature (18‑25 °C) for up to 2 hours; if processing will take longer, place the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Collect extra blood for DNA
steps.instruction: Draw an additional 1–2 mL of blood into an EDTA collection tube, transfer it to a cryotube labeled with a 2D barcode for whole‑genome sequencing, and store at –80 °C until processing.

steps.title: Centrifuge CPT tubes
steps.instruction: Spin the CPT tubes at 1500 g, room temperature, for 30 minutes (break and acceleration set to 5).

steps.title: Remove plasma and harvest cell layer
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, pipette away approximately half of the plasma into a new tube and store at –80 °C; then collect the cell layer with a Pasteur pipette and transfer it to a 15 mL Falcon tube with a cap.

steps.title: Wash cells and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL washing media to the tube, bring the total volume to 10 mL, cap the tube, and mix by inverting slowly five times.

steps.title: Centrifuge washed cells
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 5 minutes at 300 RCF.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Tip off the supernatant carefully without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in washing media
steps.instruction: Add washing media to bring the volume back to 10 mL, cap the tube, and resuspend the cells gently with a pipette.

steps.title: Count cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Mix cells 1:2 with Trypan Blue, load a Neubauer chamber, and determine cell number and viability.

steps.title: Label cryotubes with barcodes
steps.instruction: Affix 2D barcode stickers to the cryotubes while they are at room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet cells and resuspend in FCS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 300 RCF, aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of 100 % fetal calf serum (FCS), and transfer the suspension to a cryovial.

steps.title: Add freezer media and freeze
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 2X Freezer media dropwise to the cryovial, mix gently by pipetting, place the cryovial into a Mr Frosty (or CoolCell) container, and transfer it to –80 °C as quickly as possible.

substeps.instruction: Minimize the time cells are exposed to DMSO; the quicker the better.

steps.title: Transfer to liquid nitrogen storage
steps.instruction: After 24 hours at –80 °C, move the cryovials into a liquid‑nitrogen tank for long‑term storage and record the date of transfer.
